header.name: Inventory Transaction Router
header.description: This flow will route requests from the Split, Merge, Move screens.

data.query:
query Query($where: InventoryWhereInput, $orderBy: [InventoryOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  inventory(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        grossWeight
    
        netWeight
        tareWeight
        theoreticalWeight
      
        active
        barcode
        note
        trackingNumber
        customData
        inventoryStatusId
        locationId
        productStrategyProcessId
      
        lotId
        masterInventoryId
        packagingMaterialId
        supplierId
        weightUnitId
        workOrderId
        workOrderProcessId
      }
    }
  }
}
